Maya: heads-up — I'm swapping lane B (model-serving) at 15:00 PT today for release train wave 14. Need a smoke owner + rollback tag.

Jon: I can take smoke for lane B. What are the smoke steps?

Maya: thanks. Quick smoke: 1) run `curl -sS https://staging.redwood.io/health` expecting OK; 2) sanity-check generation with a short prompt; 3) check `rb status rollout/model-serving` (internal CLI). Rollback target if needed: `model-serving@v2.4.1`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: model-serving deploy at 2026-03-17T15:00:00-07:00 (slot B) — CI passed. :white_check_mark:

Jon: noted. I'll be on standby 14:45-15:20 PT. I'll run smoke and post results here.

Kevin: FYI, region cache warmup may take ~3 min after deploy. If p50/p95 latency for `/generate` stays >200ms after 5 min, consider rollback.

Tess: Who's on rollback if Jon is tied up?

Jon: If I'm tied up, Kevin will own rollback. Kevin?

Kevin: Yes, I'll be available. Rollback steps (short): `k rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=3`; then run cache drain: `kubectl scale job/cache-warmup --replicas=0`. Runbook pinned in #eng-releases.

Jon: smoke pass at 15:03 PT — health OK, sample generation looks good, basic latency within expected. :thumbsup:

Maya: amazing. Proceeding with canary 50% -> 100% per train plan. If anything odd, notify here and hit rollback.

Samir: reminder — update the release-train sheet (row B) with final image digest and time.

Jon: updated the spreadsheet and added digest sha256:abc123def456... :memo:

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: model-serving => 100% at 15:10 PT. Monitoring alarms green. :rocket:

Maya: thanks everyone. Closing slot B. :party_parrot:
